title: Food, Feed and Delivery Integrity Democratic Impact Monitor
objective: Monitor health, nutrition, animal welfare, consumer, worker, equality, privacy and anti-capture outcomes without creating a surveillance system.

affected_groups.group: Consumers, workers, small vendors, traditional producers, animal keepers and delivery workers

indicators.name: Safety and recall timeliness
indicators.definition: Time from credible signal to preservation, warning, recall and remedy.

indicators.name: Selective-enforcement disparity
indicators.definition: Comparator analysis of inspections, closures, penalties and reversals.

oversight.body: Plural independent auditor specified by enacted law
oversight.appointment_safeguard: Published criteria, plural selection, conflict disclosure and removal due process
oversight.information_remedy: court or legislative referral for unjustified withholding

complaints.retaliation_protection: Confidential intake and independent retaliation investigation

triggers.condition: Material rights harm, repeated safety failure, persistent disparity, corruption signal or data breach
triggers.correction: Published corrective plan and legislative/judicial referral

review.sunset_or_review_date: Two years after commencement and every three years thereafter
